title: Media and files of a chat
summary: The photos, videos and files of one chat, newest first (bipe-chat/bipe#672). Opens from the row bipe_gallery_title in group-details and in person-profile of a DM.

media.description: As in timeline-media: kind image, video or file.

tab.description: media: bipe_gallery_media, a grid of images and videos, three per line, square crops; a video shows its duration. files: bipe_gallery_files, a list with the file name and size.

items.description: From Room.timelineWithConfiguration with focus live and filter onlyMessage image, video and file. Newest first.

phase.description: loading: a spinner while the first pages load. empty: bipe_gallery_empty_media or bipe_gallery_empty_files for the tab.

reachedStart.description: true when back-pagination hit the start of the chat.

appear.effect: Builds the timeline and back-paginates until 30 items of the tab are loaded or reachedStart.

loadMore.effect: At the end of the grid or list: one more back-pagination while not reachedStart.

open.effect: An image or a video: a full screen pager over the media items of the gallery, as media-viewer shows a page. A file: downloads it to the cache and opens the system preview, as timeline-media does.

close.effect: Back to where the gallery opened.

notes: Stickers, voice messages and audio files are not in the gallery.
Media the server deleted after its time shows as failed, like in timeline-media.
The gallery timeline is its own timeline: it does not change the read receipts or the chat timeline.
